listing.name: Kameo: Elements of Power — ElGus KameoRecomp (ElGuslml)
listing.summary: Early Kameo port using your USA Xbox 360 ISO. Upstream reports playing Thorn’s Castle and the first Enchanted Kingdom areas; later levels are untested. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA Xbox 360 ISO. The required executable hash and media ID are not confirmed here; check upstream’s manifest before preparing files.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the released native runtime and launcher to install from your own ISO. The separate ElGusRecomps hub is optional.

warnings: Upstream reports playing Thorn’s Castle and the first Enchanted Kingdom areas in this early release. Later levels have not been tested.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
